title: Closets by smplesco
description: Compact wall storage. Or, a closet.
body:
##  **Closets by smplesco**

Ever felt like your Minecraft base was missing something? Look no further than these simple closets that can be placed on any surface and hold up to nine stacks. Never feel like your Vanilla home is incomplete thanks to these new blocks.
